title: Hide intelligence controls when the feature is off
description: An authenticated admin or power user can verify intelligence-related tabs, widgets, and buttons are hidden across farm, stage, sector, and enclosure views while core operational data remains visible.

Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /farm
